motivation: Same-mask GT ID diagnostic shows a large association gap; use visual object continuity rather than another neural adaptation module.
selection: exactly preserved sealed KD / exemplar selected boxes; only output IDs may change
candidate_connections: nonoverlapping source tracks with gap1..30, constant-velocity error <= one mean box-height, endpoint visual distance <= image-only90th percentile same-track start/end distance
assignment: maximum-benefit bipartite matching with dummy zero-cost successor and a temporal DAG
features: six endpoint frozen query0 PCD descriptors per source track; semantic endpoints from exact current-prefix frozen-feature frame KD
controls: original IDs for exact same mask
apply same associations to ordinary KD and exemplar masks
adaptation_supervision: images, queries and frozen teacher only; no target GT
caveats: stitching does not repair switches inside a source track
same boxes isolate association from count/ranking
costs: actual endpoint read/matching wall recorded; upstream frame KD cue cost must also be charged; no live cold-time claim
evaluation: official complete C4/C1 HOTA and original-parent bootstrap after sealing; keep negatives
